reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Suggested keeping the Kconfig description hidden and making it follow KVM_INTEL instead. Provided a rationale for why this would work.

reviews.author: Dmitry Voytik
reviews.summary: Responded to Kiryl's suggestion by retesting and sending a v2 of the patch. Provided evidence that it can be built as =m.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Kiryl,

Thanks for the review!

On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 1:42 PM Kiryl Shutsemau <kas@kernel.org> wrote:
>
> On Sun, Oct 04, 2026 at 12:32:37AM +0200, Dmitry Voytik wrote:
> > Fix the issue when the driver always gets compiled as a module.
> > How to reproduce the issue:
> >       make mrproper
> >       make defconfig
> >
> >       ./scripts/config \
> >         -e CMA \
> >         -e ALLOC \
> >         -e KVM \
> >         -e KVM_INTEL \
> >         -e KVM_INTEL_TDX \
> >         -e INTEL_TDX_HOST \
> >         -e TDX_HOST_SERVICES \
> >         --refresh
> >       make olddefconfig
> >       make mod2yesconfig
> >       grep '=m$' .config
> >
> >       returns only this driver as module:
> >         CONFIG_TDX_HOST_SERVICES=m
> >
> > "make menuconfig" doesn't let switch from =m to =y either.
> >
> > Signed-off-by: Dmitry Voytik <voytikd@gmail.com>
> > ---
> >  drivers/virt/coco/tdx-host/Kconfig | 6 +++++-
> >  1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
> >
> > diff --git a/drivers/virt/coco/tdx-host/Kconfig b/drivers/virt/coco/tdx-host/Kconfig
> > index 57d0c01a4357..5a13ec6f51e8 100644
> > --- a/drivers/virt/coco/tdx-host/Kconfig
> > +++ b/drivers/virt/coco/tdx-host/Kconfig
> > @@ -1,6 +1,10 @@
> >  config TDX_HOST_SERVICES
> > -     tristate
> > +     tristate "TDX host user interface driver"
> >       depends on INTEL_TDX_HOST
> >       select FW_LOADER
> >       select FW_UPLOAD
> >       default m
> > +     help
> > +       See INTEL_TDX_HOST for details.
> > +
> > +       If unsure, say N.
>
> I would rather keep it hidden and make it follow KVM_INTEL instead:
>
> config TDX_HOST_SERVICES
>         tristate
>         depends on INTEL_TDX_HOST
>         select FW_LOADER
>         select FW_UPLOAD
>         default KVM_INTEL
>
> INTEL_TDX_HOST depends on KVM_INTEL, so this gives =m with kvm-intel as a
> module and =y with it built in, which covers your mod2yesconfig case.
>
> Does it work for you?

Sure, I've retested and sent a v2.

I also rechecked that it still can be built as =m:
./scripts/config \
 -e CMA \
 -e ALLOC \
 -e KVM \
 -m KVM_INTEL \
 -e KVM_INTEL_TDX \
 -e INTEL_TDX_HOST \
 -m TDX_HOST_SERVICES \
 --refresh
I did this because sashiko produced a false warning that it can't be
built as =m.

Thanks!

> --
>   Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

2026-10-12.patch_summary: Patch author Dmitry Voytik added Kconfig description for TDX host services, and Kiryl Shutsemau reviewed it.
